title: CustomAnvilRenameable
description: This mod prevents you from renaming specific items or all items from particular mod using an anvil.
body:
### No effect without configuring the settings file
This mod prevents you from renaming specific items or all items from a particular mod using an anvil.

The default is blacklist mode—items matching the configuration cannot be renamed via anvil.

Disabling blacklist mode switches to whitelist mode—only items matching the configuration can be renamed using an anvil.
